title: Nasty Liq Mango Peach Pineapple 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid By Nasty Juice
description: Nasty Liq's Mango Peach Pineapple is a masterful blend that weaves together the irresistible essences of three beloved summer fruits. Each puff is an indulgence in tropical mango, its rich and sweet notes setting the foundation for a truly exotic vape. The mango's lushness is complemented by the succulence of ripe peaches, which introduce a soft, velvety layer to the flavour profile. As you're enveloped by the mango and peach, a twist of tangy pineapple emerges, cutting through the sweetness with its vibrant acidity. The pineapple's boldness ensures the e-liquid remains balanced and provides a refreshing finish that cleanses the palate, making each inhale every bit as tasty as the first. This flavourful trio is a vaper's ticket to a tropical getaway, a combination that’s both comforting and exciting. With its 50VG/50PG blend, Mango Peach Pineapple is tailored for a satisfying vape, producing a harmonious balance of thick clouds and rich taste. The nic salt formula enhances this blend, offering a smooth draw that's perfect for vapers who prefer a gentler throat hit. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the Nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape kit devices. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more delicious Nasty Liq flavours to try. Nasty Juice have fine-tuned their vape juices for optimised performance with the vast majority of MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices. They feature exceptional flavours and flavour blends across fruits, sweets, desserts and tobacco and many are also available in Nasty Juice’s super-convenient Nasty Bar disposable vape bars.
